priorityList: Interrupt with Mind Freeze whenever possible.
Cast Reaper's Mark if Pillar of Frost is ready or will be ready within 1.5 seconds.
Cast Pillar of Frost if Reaper's Mark is on cooldown (more than 10s remaining) or recently applied.
Activate Breath of Sindragosa during Pillar of Frost if you have at least 60 Runic Power.
Cast Remorseless Winter on cooldown if talented into Gathering Storm.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury at the very end of Pillar of Frost or when Unholy Strength is about to expire.
Use Empower Rune Weapon if you have fewer than 2 Runes or if Killing Machine is not active.
Cast Obliterate if you have 2 stacks of Killing Machine, or 1 stack with 3+ Runes available.
Cast Howling Blast on Rime procs if you have the Frostbound Will talent or if Frost Fever is not ticking.
Cast Frost Strike if the target has 5 stacks of Razorice and you have the Shattering Blade talent.
Cast Howling Blast on any Rime proc.
Cast Frost Strike if you are near maximum Runic Power to avoid capping.
Cast Obliterate if Killing Machine is active and you are not pooling Runes for an upcoming Reaper's Mark.
Cast Frost Strike to spend excess Runic Power as a general filler.
Cast Obliterate as a filler when not pooling Runes and not in a specialized window.
